crossRefs.note: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has…

translations.web: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
translations.bsb: As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.”
translations.kjv: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
translations.asv: while it is said, To-day if ye shall hear his voice, Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
